mapper.select: select lr.leave_request_id, lr.emp_id, e.ename, d.department_name, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.days from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id join emp e on e.emp_id = lr.emp_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id where lr.status = 'APPROVED' and lr.start_date <= #{to} and lr.end_date >= #{from} order by lr.start_date, d.department_id, e.emp_id
